definitions.gloss: main part; chief; principal (as opposed to secondary)
definitions.explanation: The main or central part of something, as opposed to what is secondary ({従|じゅう}). Mostly found in set expressions such as {主|しゅ}として (mainly) and {主|しゅ}たる (principal), and in many compounds ({主語|しゅご}, {主食|しゅしょく}).

definitions.gloss: the Lord (God or Christ, in Christianity)
definitions.explanation: In Christian usage, God or Jesus Christ as Lord, as in {主|しゅ}イエス・キリスト and {主|しゅ}の{祈|いの}り (the Lord's Prayer).

examples.japanese: ⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{主|しゅ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧だった。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親睦|しんぼく}→親睦：09128_shinboku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{主|しゅ}で、⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{従|じゅう}だ。
examples.english: This group is mainly social; studying comes second.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{主|しゅ}たる→主たる：32384_shutaru⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{運転手|うんてんしゅ}→運転手：01333_untenshu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{居眠|いねむ}り→居眠り：01822_inemuri⟧だった⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}られている→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: The principal cause of the accident is thought to have been the driver falling asleep.

examples.japanese: {主|しゅ}⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧、⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{主|しゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祈|いの}り→祈り：13732_inori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}えた→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧。
examples.english: We said the Lord's Prayer at church.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{礼拝|れいはい}→礼拝：16972_reihai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{牧師|ぼくし}→牧師：18229_bokushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「{主|しゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦あなた→あなた：02565_anata⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{共|とも}にいます」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{語|かた}った→語る：01930_kataru⟧。
examples.english: At the Sunday service, the minister said, "The Lord is always with you."

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {主|しゅ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: mainly, chiefly (written; ⟦{主|おも}に→主に：01607_omoni⟧ in speech)
- ⟦{主|しゅ}たる→主たる：32384_shutaru⟧ + noun: principal, main (formal)
- {主|しゅ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{従|じゅう}: main and secondary

WATCH OUT:
The same kanji has several readings with different words: ⟦{主|おも}な→主な：21018_omona⟧ / ⟦{主|おも}に→主に：01607_omoni⟧ (main / mainly), ⟦{主|ぬし}→主：30578_nushi⟧ (owner, master, as in ⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧), and ⟦{主|あるじ}→主：19365_aruji⟧ (master of a house). On its own, {主|しゅ} is read しゅ mainly in the patterns above and in Christian usage.
